messages.text: The north quarry closed at 20:00 UTC.
The north quarry gate is still admitting carts.
The closure notice is posted at the office.
Two loaded carts entered after 20:00 UTC.

main_story.headline: Discrepancies reported at the north quarry
main_story.lede: Residents clashed over the status of industrial operations at the north quarry following its scheduled closure.
main_story.body: Operational timelines for the north quarry became a point of contention late yesterday evening. Uma maintained that the facility ceased operations at 20:00 UTC, citing an official notice posted at the site office as evidence of the transition. Despite this, Vik reported witnessing activity at the gates well after the posted deadline. According to Vik, at least two loaded carts were admitted to the site after 20:00 UTC, directly contradicting the official closure order mentioned by Uma. The discrepancy suggests a failure in communication between administrative staff and site security personnel, leaving locals to debate whether the site remains under active status or if the observed traffic was merely an administrative error in the final hours of the work cycle.

image.caption: The main gate of the north quarry remains a point of observation for local residents.
